description: Hire a specific human. Pass fundingMethod: wallet and a stable idempotencyKey to reserve existing wallet funds including fees, without checkout or auto-top-up. A short wallet returns insufficient_wallet_funds and required/available/shortfall cents; add funds and retry the same key. Wallet retries with the same key return the same hire, including after cancellation; changed inputs need a new key. Omit fundingMethod for a hosted checkout: it returns checkoutUrl for the account owner to pay, and the hire is funded and the human assigned only after payment. Without wallet funding, each call starts a new hire and checkout link. If checkout returns status insufficient_funds, add wallet funds and retry with fundingMethod: wallet and a new idempotencyKey; profile_country_required means set your country at setupUrl first. Funding holds escrow and does not pay the worker. After work, use confirm_delivery and release_payment. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY.

estimatedHours.description: Hours of work, at least 0.083 (5 minutes); defaults to 1
estimatedHours.title: greaterThanOrEqualTo(0.08333333333333333)

fundingMethod.description: wallet spends existing wallet funds; omit it (or pass checkout) for a hosted checkout link.

humanId.description: Profile ID of the human to hire
humanId.title: minLength(1)

idempotencyKey.description: 1-200 characters; required with fundingMethod wallet. Reuse it only to retry the same hire.
idempotencyKey.title: maxLength(200)

price.description: Worker pay in USD, 1-10,000; fees are added on top
price.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(10000)

taskDescription.description: What to do, at least 10 characters
taskDescription.title: minLength(10)

name: rent_human
